Thanksgiving Dinner Is Set to Cost Americans More This Year, Says Farm Bureau. Here’s Why

The American Farm Bureau Federation (AFBF) estimates that the cost of Thanksgiving dinner this year will be up more than 6% compared to last year, with steep turkey prices and higher fuel costs driving up the bill. The average 10-person dinner will cost $58.63, compared to $55.18 in 2025, according to the bureau’s annual report .
